summary: Navigator Holdings Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting an October 8, 2026 Agreement and Plan of Merger among the Company, its wholly owned subsidiary Navigator Gas plc (Parent), and Navigator Gas Merger Co Inc. The Company will merge into Merger Sub, each outstanding Common Share converting into one ordinary share of Parent. The transaction implements a previously announced change of corporate domicile from the Marshall Islands to England and Wales, structured as a US-equivalent reincorporation/redomiciliation merger, not a change-of-control sale. Closing requires majority shareholder approval and F-4 effectiveness. No price, premium, or cash consideration is involved.
